title: Two windows: the later pick on the one field wins and Parts goes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A.
  • Open the work order in two windows of a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, side by side, both showing the one "Sales Representative" field.
custom_steps:
1. In the first window, hover over the Sales Representative field.
  2. In the first window, click the + button.
  3. In the first window, click "Sales Representative - Parts".
  4. In the second window, without reloading, click the Sales Representative field.
  5. In the second window, click sales rep B in the dropdown.
  6. Wait until the second window's change has saved. Do not reload either window.
  7. Reload the first window.
  8. Reload the second window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The + button shows beside the field.

Step 2:

  • A menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The first window shows "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both reading sales rep A.

Step 4:

  • The second window's dropdown opens.

Step 5:

  • The second window's dropdown closes.
  • Its one field reads sales rep B.

Step 6:

  • Once its save finishes, the second window shows what was saved: one "Sales Representative" field reading sales rep B.

Step 7:

  • The first window now shows one "Sales Representative" field reading sales rep B.
  • The Parts field is gone.

Step 8:

  • The second window still shows one "Sales Representative" field reading sales rep B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-E6: “When the same work order is open in two places and one adds the Parts field while the other, still showing the one field, then picks a person, the later save wins: the work order ends with the one Sales Representative field holding the person picked last, and the Parts field is gone. Each screen shows what was saved once its save finishes.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 6: “6. (a) Tab B's choice wins and the Parts field disappears: the later save wins, as everywhere else.”
